pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:Honesty? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on:Honesty has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith on:Honesty to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Honesty with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:Honesty.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

4. Which response best shows understanding of Believe in? (1 mark)
   A. Say Believe in has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Believe in.
   C. Apply the teaching of Believe in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Believe in to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Early life of the prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Early life of the prophet.
   B. Use Early life of the prophet to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Early life of the prophet has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Early life of the prophet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on: Respect? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: Respect with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on: Respect to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on: Respect.
   D. Say Hadith on: Respect has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of.
   B. Say Pillars of has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Pillars of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pillars of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

11. Which response best shows understanding of Environment? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Environment with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Environment to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment.
   D. Say Environment has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick? (1 mark)
   A. Use Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick.
   D. Apply the teaching of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain care for plants and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. (4 marks)
